metadata.description: Plugins for the nhruska.github.io Music app - agent-side capabilities built on the app's file-interchange contract (offline-first, no server).

plugins.name: music-coach
plugins.description: Personal music-learning coach: assess exported skill profiles, build practice plans, emit one-tap jam deep links, and render analytics reports - via the app's self-describing exports. Skills, commands, and agent personas included.
